title: feat(011why6): t(6,0,0)=10 under (0,1,1) via cheap seed-exit corridor
science: Mechanism for the (0,1,1) same-k failure at k=6 (#6784): exhibits both lex-first walks on B_18(0) -- axis t(6,0,0)=10 by a seven-hop corridor plus one cost-3 support drop (vs 16 on-axis), body t(6,6,6)=18 all cost-1 -- so the body arrival equals its l1 length exactly while the axis pays a fixed +4. Adds something the other 'why' notes do not: a DAG path COUNT, exactly 8 distinct shortest paths to (6,0,0), i.e. a geodesic degeneracy measure.
